title.narrative: 15 May 2019 | Video: https://www.adb.org/news/videos/urban-services-mongolias-booming-border-towns
16 Nov 2018 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/adb-opens-new-wastewater-treatment-plant-arvaikheer-mongolia
27 Sep 2018 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/adb-expands-wastewater-project-5-additional-mongolia-aimags
Grant 0204: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 06 Mar 2025
Loan 3388: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 06 Mar 2025
Loan 3713: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 06 Mar 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Training of PUSO staff was completed by 2020 under Grant 0204 and Loan 3388. The institutional development and capacity building consultants, recruited under Loan 3713, have conducted a series of training sessions t the staff of five participating PUSOs. Cumulatively, 308 PUSO staff were trained, of which 35% were women.
All infrastructure facilities planned under the project have been constructed and put into operation. The project has been achieving its development goals and the targets at outcome and output levels.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Mar 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42184/42184-022-apfs-en_6.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Mar 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42184/42184-024-42184-022-iee-en.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jul 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42184/42184-027-rp-mn_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42184/42184-027-smr-en.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Output 1. Completed. Package A4 consultants provided advisory services to local governments in identifying a suitable PPP transaction mode approach for public utility services organization (PUSO). Due to unavailability of funds to finance a service fee, replacement of replace operating management contract approach with a lease contract for the existing PUSOs has been proposed. The lease contract includes setting tariffs that will recover operational and maintenance costs including depreciation, service quality targets and required investment.
Output 2. Completed. Urban master plans for four soums have been prepared, approved and handed over to the aimag governments.
Output 3. Completed. Working group was established by the Government.
Output 4. Completed. The project constructed under (i) G0204: one 1,000 m3 water reservoir and four 100 m3 water reservoirs (one each in Dalanzadgad and Gurvantes and two in Tsogttsetsii); (ii) L3388: one 100m3 water reservoir in Khujirt soum of Uvurkhangai aimag, and (iii) L3713: two reservoirs with 48m3/d capacity in Erdenedalai, Dundgovi aimag. In total, the project installed 72.85 km water supply pipelines (185% of the target). The project built 39.4 km of water supply pipeline under G0204 (1.4 km in Dalanzadgad, 6.8km in Sainshand, 13.4km in Zamyn-Uud, 5.7 km in Gurvantes, 6.6km in Tsogttsetsii, 5.5km in Khanbogd), 28.36 km under L3388 and 5.07 km - under L3713. In total, the project installed 72.85 km water supply pipelines (185%).
Output 5. Completed. The project installed in total 79.44 km sewer pipes, including 32.98 km under G0204, 22.95 km under L3388, and 23.51 km under L3713.The project constructed (i) under G0204, two WWTPs with 800 m3 capacity each (in Gurvantes and Khanbogd soums); (ii) under L3388 and L3713, nine WWTPs of 3,000 m3/day capacity each and two additional treatment plants (in Erdenedalai soum (50m3/d) and Khujrt soum (320m3/d capacity). The vacuum sewage trucks and machineries for PUSOs were supplied to proejct PUSOs.
Output 6. Completed. Under Grant 0204, the project constructed 10.2 km heating supply pipelines by 2016. Loan 31713 financed construction of additional 5.1 km heating supply pipelines in 2020.
Output 7. Completed. In Khanbogd soum, 5 km road was constructed from the source other than the grant (by Oyu Tolgoi), hence at the local government request the project built only 6 km road in the project towns (Sainshand and Tsogtsetsii).
Output 8. Completed. Two landfill sites were constructed under the provincial government budget in Tsogtsetsii and Sainshand soums. Hence, project constructed one landfill site in Zamyn-Uud, and, at the government request, built a waste compaction transfer station and supplied additional waste segregation bins, containers and machinery.
Output 9. Completed. Under G0204, 1.8 km storm drainage was built in accordance with the detailed engineering design.
Output 10. Completed. The project conducted training and capacity building sessions for local government and PUSO staff in nine participating provinces. Women participation in these sessions had been recorded and reported.
Output 5. Completed. The project installed in total 79.44 km sewer pipes, including 32.98 km under G0204, 22.95 km under L3388, and 23.51 km under L3713.The project constructed (i) under G0204, two WWTPs with 800 m3 capacity each (in Gurvantes and Khanbogd soums); (ii) under L3388 and L3713, nine WWTPs of 3,000 m3/day capacity each and two additional treatment plants (in Erdenedalai soum (50m3/d) and Khujrt soum (320m3/d capacity). The vacuum sewage trucks and machineries for PUSOs were supplied to project PUSOs.
TA 9100: 94% disbursed as of 06 Mar 2025
